auth_type.correction: apiKey (optional but recommended; unauthenticated access still allowed with stricter rate limits)

free_tier_limits.correction: No monetary free-tier quota; public service with rate limits. API key free via NCBI account. Without key: 3 req/s; with key: 10 req/s. Recommended max 10 concurrent requests. Large jobs should use EDirect or local copies; third-party commercial redistribution may need NCBI permission.

rate_limits.correction: Without API key: 3 requests/second. With API key: 10 requests/second. Recommended not to exceed 10 concurrent requests. Do not post more than 100 UIDs per request for multi-UID operations; use history server for larger sets. Contact eutilities@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov for higher throughput needs.

description.correction: NCBI E-utilities (Entrez Programming Utilities) is a set of eight server-side programs providing a stable API into the Entrez query and database system at NCBI (PubMed, GenBank, etc.). Access is free; an optional free API key raises the rate limit. Responses available in XML and JSON (retmode). Base URL: https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/.

notes: Entry is nearly empty (base_url, docs_url, description, rate_limits, example blank). Official base is eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov; auth is optional api_key not none; formats include XML not only JSON. Automated HTTP 0 likely network/env, not API death. CORS not documented.
